1: # openvela VoiceLink
2: 
3: ## 一、作品简介
4: 
5: openvela VoiceLink 是面向无屏、无键盘设备的离线语音配网应用，运行目标为 K7 + openvela。用户说出大赛统一唤醒词“你好，openvela”或“Hello，openvela”后，可通过语音完成 Wi-Fi 扫描、选网和密码逐字符输入。密码只需输入一遍；连接失败时系统通过 TTS 播报原因并允许重试，密码内容不会写入日志。
6: 
7: 项目采用 C++17 实现业务状态机，通过 Port/Adapter 分层与板级语音、音频和 Wi-Fi 驱动解耦，可在没有开发板时用主机单元测试验证核心逻辑。
8: 
9: ## 二、选题方向
10: 
11: **AI 硬件产品创新。**
12: 
13: 本作品针对无屏、无键盘 IoT 设备首次联网的实际问题，提供全离线、纯语音的配网交互，不依赖云端服务、显示屏或键盘。
14: 
15: ## 三、目录结构
16: 
17: ```text
18: app/openvela-voicelink/       VoiceLink 作品代码
19:   include/voicelink/          业务接口与板级接口契约
20:   src/                        状态机、解析器、openvela 适配层
21:   tests/                      主机单元测试
22:   scripts/                    openvela 工作区集成脚本
23:   docs/                       真机联调与软件交付说明
24: logs/                         AI Coding 日志
25: ```
26: 
27: 组委会提供的 `hello_app`、`hello_quickapp` 和 `contest_board` 示例骨架暂时保留，实际参赛作品为 `app/openvela-voicelink/`。
28: 
29: ## 四、运行方式
30: 
31: ### 4.1 主机侧构建与测试
32: 
33: 主机侧用于验证不依赖开发板的状态机和解析逻辑，需要支持 C++17 的 CMake、Ninja/Make 和编译器：
34: 
35: ```sh
36: cd contest2026_483_yuanxinshixisheng/app/openvela-voicelink
37: cmake -S . -B build
38: cmake --build build
39: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
40: ```
41: 
42: 测试覆盖唤醒词、语音文本解析、网络选择、密码输入/清除、连接失败重试和 I/O 状态处理。
43: 
44: ### 4.2 K7 + openvela 集成
45: 
46: 在 `repo init`、`repo sync` 得到的 openvela 工作区中，manifest 会把作品映射到：
47: 
48: ```text
49: packages/demos/contest2026_483_openvela_voicelink
50: ```
51: 
52: 板级负责人需要先实现：
53: 
54: - `include/voicelink/speech_engine.h` 声明的录音、ASR、TTS 接口；
55: - `src/board_hooks_k7.c` 中的 VS6621SR80 Wi-Fi 扫描与连接接口；
56: - K7 BSP、ES8388 音频、固件烧录和真机验收。
57: 
58: 完成板级接口后，在 openvela 工作区根目录配置硬件成员提供的 board config，
59: 在 menuconfig 中启用 `APP_VOICELINK`，然后构建：
60: 
61: ```sh
62: ./build.sh <board-config-path> menuconfig
63: ./build.sh <board-config-path> -j8
64: ```
65: 
66: 烧录固件后在 NSH 启动：
67: 
68: ```text
69: nsh> voicelink
70: ```
71: 
72: 完整接口契约和八项真机验收步骤见 `app/openvela-voicelink/docs/ENGINEER_CHECKLIST.md`。
73: 
74: ## 五、软件侧实现与分工
75: 
76: 非硬件成员负责：
77: 
78: - 语音配网状态机与错误恢复；
79: - 唤醒、选网、密码字符和控制词解析；
80: - 密码内存清理及禁止日志泄露；
81: - 主机单元测试、CMake 与 openvela 应用构建文件；
82: - 板级接口契约、运行文档和参赛提交材料。
83: 
84: 硬件成员负责 K7 BSP、ES8388 音频、VS6621SR80 Wi-Fi 驱动、语音引擎板级实现、烧录与真机验证。
85: 
86: ## 六、AI Coding 使用说明
87: 
88: AI 参与了需求拆解、状态机设计、唤醒词与密码解析实现、异常路径测试、软硬件接口梳理、构建验证和提交文档整理。AI 协作的原始会话日志按成员 GitHub 账号保存在 `logs/`，并随代码一并提交。

12:   volatile char* bytes = value.empty() ? nullptr : value.data();
13:   for (std::size_t i = 0; i < value.size(); ++i) bytes[i] = 0;
14:   value.clear();

21:     : tts_(tts), wifi_(wifi), config_(std::move(config)) {
22:   if (config_.wake_words.empty()) config_.wake_words = defaultWakeWords();
23:   if (config_.min_password_length > config_.max_password_length)
24:     config_.min_password_length = config_.max_password_length;

31: void Controller::resetToWake() {
32:   wipePassword();
33:   context_ = Context{};
34:   context_.state = State::WaitingWake;
35:   context_.grammar = Grammar::WakeWord;
36:   // Never speak the wake phrase while arming KWS; doing so can self-trigger.
37:   tts_.stop();
38: }

40: void Controller::ingest(const std::string& text) {
41:   switch (context_.state) {
42:     case State::WaitingWake:
43:       if (isWakeWord(text, config_.wake_words)) {
44:         if (!tts_.speak(config_.greeting)) {
45:           context_.state = State::Error;
46:           return;
47:         }
48:         beginScan();
49:       }
50:       return;
51:     case State::WaitingNetworkChoice:
52:       handleNetwork(text);
53:       return;
54:     case State::EnteringPassword:
55:       handlePassword(text);
56:       return;
57:     default:
58:       return;
59:   }
60: }

62: bool Controller::handleInputStatus(IoStatus status) {
63:   switch (status) {
64:     case IoStatus::Ok:
65:       return true;  // caller should have used ingest()
66:     case IoStatus::Timeout:
67:       // No speech within the listen window: keep the current state and wait.
68:       return true;
69:     case IoStatus::RetryableError:
70:       // Brief prompt, retry the same grammar — state unchanged.
71:       repeat("没有听清，请再说一次");
72:       return context_.state != State::Error;
73:     case IoStatus::EndOfInput:
74:       // Input source exhausted: wipe secrets and signal the caller to exit.
75:       wipePassword();
76:       return false;
77:     case IoStatus::FatalError:
78:       wipePassword();
79:       context_.state = State::Error;
80:       return false;
81:   }
82:   return false;
83: }

85: void Controller::beginScan() {
86:   wipePassword();
87:   context_.state = State::ScanningWifi;
88:   context_.selected_index.reset();
89:   context_.candidates.clear();
90:   ScanResult result;
91: #if defined(__cpp_exceptions) || defined(__EXCEPTIONS)
92:   try {
93:     result = wifi_.scan();
94:   } catch (...) {
95:     setTerminal(State::Error, "扫描失败，已停止当前流程");
96:     return;
97:   }
98: #else
99:   result = wifi_.scan();
100: #endif
101:   // -ENOSYS, scan failure, or any non-Ok status must NOT be disguised as an
102:   // empty scan. Only a genuine successful scan with zero APs prompts rescan.
103:   if (result.status != IoStatus::Ok) {
104:     setTerminal(State::Error, "扫描失败，已停止当前流程");
105:     return;
106:   }
107:   std::unordered_map<std::string, AccessPoint> best;
108:   for (auto& ap : result.access_points) {
109:     if (ap.ssid.empty()) continue;
110:     const auto found = best.find(ap.ssid);
111:     if (found == best.end() || ap.rssi > found->second.rssi) best[ap.ssid] = ap;
112:   }
113:   for (auto& item : best) context_.candidates.push_back(std::move(item.second));
114:   std::sort(context_.candidates.begin(), context_.candidates.end(),
115:             [](const AccessPoint& a, const AccessPoint& b) { return a.rssi > b.rssi; });
116:   if (context_.candidates.size() > config_.max_networks)
117:     context_.candidates.resize(config_.max_networks);
118:   context_.state = State::WaitingNetworkChoice;
119:   context_.grammar = Grammar::NetworkSelection;
120:   announceNetworks();
121: }
122: 
123: void Controller::announceNetworks() {
124:   if (context_.candidates.empty()) {
125:     repeat("没有发现网络，请说重新扫描或取消");
126:     return;
127:   }
128:   static const char* names[] = {"一", "二", "三", "四", "五"};
129:   std::string message = "发现以下网络。";
130:   for (std::size_t i = 0; i < context_.candidates.size(); ++i)
131:     message += "网络" + std::string(names[i]) + "，" + context_.candidates[i].ssid + "。";
132:   repeat(message + "请选择网络。");
133: }
134: 
135: void Controller::handleNetwork(const std::string& text) {
136:   if (isRescan(text)) {
137:     beginScan();
138:     return;
139:   }
140:   if (isCancel(text)) {
141:     setTerminal(State::Idle, "已取消配置");
142:     return;
143:   }
144:   const auto index = parseNetworkIndex(text);
145:   if (!index || *index < 1 || static_cast<std::size_t>(*index) > context_.candidates.size()) {
146:     repeat("编号无效，请重新选择网络");
147:     return;
148:   }
149:   context_.selected_index = static_cast<std::size_t>(*index - 1);
150:   const auto& ap = context_.candidates[*context_.selected_index];
151:   if (!ap.secured) {
152:     tryConnect(nullptr, 0);
153:     return;
154:   }
155:   context_.state = State::EnteringPassword;
156:   context_.grammar = Grammar::PasswordToken;
157:   repeat("已选择" + ap.ssid + "，请逐个输入密码字符，完成后说完成");
158: }
159: 
160: void Controller::handlePassword(const std::string& text) {
161:   if (isNetworkRestart(text)) {
162:     beginScan();
163:     return;
164:   }
165:   const auto token = parsePasswordToken(text);
166:   if (!token) {
167:     repeat("没有听清，请再说一次当前字符");
168:     return;
169:   }
170:   if (token->control) {
171:     handlePasswordControl(*token->control);
172:     return;
173:   }
174:   auto& password = context_.password;
175:   if (password.size() >= config_.max_password_length) {
176:     repeat("已达到最大长度，请说完成、删除、清空、重输或取消");
177:     return;
178:   }
179:   password.push_back(*token->character);
180:   repeat("已输入第" + std::to_string(password.size()) + "个字符");
181: }
182: 
183: void Controller::handlePasswordControl(PasswordControl control) {
184:   auto& password = context_.password;
185:   switch (control) {
186:     case PasswordControl::Finish:
187:       finishPasswordRound();
188:       break;
189:     case PasswordControl::DeleteLast:
190:       if (!password.empty()) {
191:         password.back() = 0;
192:         password.pop_back();
193:       }
194:       repeat("当前长度为" + std::to_string(password.size()));
195:       break;
196:     case PasswordControl::Clear:
197:       secureWipe(password);
198:       repeat("已清空，请重新输入密码");
199:       break;
200:     case PasswordControl::Restart:
201:       wipePassword();
202:       context_.state = State::EnteringPassword;
203:       repeat("已重新开始，请输入密码");
204:       break;
205:     case PasswordControl::Cancel:
206:       setTerminal(State::Idle, "已取消配置");
207:       break;
208:     case PasswordControl::ReportLength:
209:       repeat("当前长度为" + std::to_string(password.size()));
210:       break;
211:   }
212: }
213: 
214: void Controller::finishPasswordRound() {
215:   auto& password = context_.password;
216:   if (password.size() < config_.min_password_length) {
217:     repeat("密码长度不足，请继续输入");
218:     return;
219:   }
220:   tryConnect(password.data(), password.size());
221: }
222: 
223: void Controller::tryConnect(const char* password, std::size_t password_len) {
224:   if (!context_.selected_index ||
225:       *context_.selected_index >= context_.candidates.size()) {
226:     setTerminal(State::Error, "连接失败，已停止当前流程");
227:     return;
228:   }
229:   const auto& ap = context_.candidates[*context_.selected_index];
230:   const std::string ssid = ap.ssid;
231:   const bool secured = ap.secured;
232:   ConnectResult result;
233: #if defined(__cpp_exceptions) || defined(__EXCEPTIONS)
234:   try {
235:     result = wifi_.connect(ssid, password, password_len);
236:   } catch (...) {
237:     result.status = ConnectStatus::Failed;
238:   }
239: #else
240:   result = wifi_.connect(ssid, password, password_len);
241: #endif
242:   wipePassword();
243:   if (result.status == ConnectStatus::Ok) {
244:     setTerminal(State::Completed, "已连接到" + ssid);
245:     return;
246:   }
247:   if (!secured) {
248:     context_.state = State::WaitingNetworkChoice;
249:     context_.grammar = Grammar::NetworkSelection;
250:     repeat("连接失败，请重新选择网络");
251:     return;
252:   }
253:   context_.state = State::EnteringPassword;
254:   context_.grammar = Grammar::PasswordToken;
255:   if (result.status == ConnectStatus::WrongPassword) {
256:     repeat("密码错误，请重新输入");
257:     return;
258:   }
259:   if (result.status == ConnectStatus::Timeout) {
260:     repeat("连接超时，请重新输入密码");
261:     return;
262:   }
263:   if (result.status == ConnectStatus::NetworkNotFound) {
264:     repeat("找不到该网络，请重新输入密码或重新选择网络");
265:     return;
266:   }
267:   repeat("连接失败，请重新输入密码");
268: }
269: 
270: void Controller::repeat(const std::string& text) {
271:   tts_.stop();
272:   if (!tts_.speak(text)) context_.state = State::Error;
273: }
274: 
275: void Controller::wipePassword() { secureWipe(context_.password); }
276: 
277: void Controller::setTerminal(State state, const std::string& text) {
278:   wipePassword();
279:   context_.state = state;
280:   repeat(text);
281: }
282: 
283: }  // namespace voicelink

43: char chineseDigit(const std::string& text) {
44:   static const std::unordered_map<std::string, char> digits{
45:       {"零", '0'}, {"一", '1'}, {"二", '2'}, {"三", '3'}, {"四", '4'},
46:       {"五", '5'}, {"六", '6'}, {"七", '7'}, {"八", '8'}, {"九", '9'}};
47:   const auto found = digits.find(text);
48:   return found == digits.end() ? '\0' : found->second;

53: std::string normalize(const std::string& text) {
54:   std::string result;
55:   result.reserve(text.size());
56:   for (unsigned char ch : text) {
57:     if (ch < 0x80) {
58:       if (!std::isspace(ch)) result.push_back(static_cast<char>(std::tolower(ch)));
59:     } else {
60:       result.push_back(static_cast<char>(ch));
61:     }
62:   }
63:   for (const auto* punctuation : {"，", "。", "、", "！", "？", "；", "：", "“", "”", "《", "》", "（", "）", "～"}) {
64:     eraseAll(result, punctuation);
65:   }
66:   return result;
67: }
68: 
69: namespace {
70: 
71: // 唤醒短语折叠：先 normalize()（ASCII 转小写、去空白、去常用中文标点），
72: // 再丢掉所有 ASCII 标点，最后补删 normalize() 未覆盖的全角符号。
73: // ASR 常输出半角逗号/句点（"Hello, openvela"），不折叠会漏唤醒。
74: // 注意：不改 normalize() 本身，密码解析依赖其中的 '.'、'#' 等符号语义。
75: std::string foldWakePhrase(const std::string& text) {
76:   const std::string normalized = normalize(text);
77:   std::string folded;
78:   folded.reserve(normalized.size());
79:   for (unsigned char ch : normalized) {
80:     if (ch < 0x80) {
81:       if (std::isalnum(ch) != 0) folded.push_back(static_cast<char>(ch));
82:     } else {
83:       folded.push_back(static_cast<char>(ch));
84:     }
85:   }
86:   for (const auto* punctuation :
87:        {"…", "·", "「", "」", "『", "』", "【", "】", "〈", "〉"}) {
88:     eraseAll(folded, punctuation);
89:   }
90:   return folded;
91: }
92: 
93: // 全等比较，或剥掉一层礼貌前缀后全等比较。大赛唤醒词是「礼貌前缀 + 品牌名」
94: // 的结构，前缀可选、品牌名必须完整，所以「hello」「你好」单独出现不会唤醒，
95: // 「小信」「openvela123」也不会唤醒。
96: bool matchesWakePhrase(const std::string& actual, const std::string& wanted) {
97:   if (actual.empty() || wanted.empty()) return false;
98:   if (actual == wanted) return true;
99:   static const std::vector<std::string> kPrefixes{
100:       "你好", "您好", "嗨", "嘿", "哈喽", "哈啰", "hello", "hi", "hey"};
101:   for (const auto& prefix : kPrefixes) {
102:     if (actual.size() <= prefix.size()) continue;
103:     if (actual.compare(0, prefix.size(), prefix) != 0) continue;
104:     if (actual.compare(prefix.size(), std::string::npos, wanted) == 0) return true;
105:   }
106:   return false;
107: }
108: 
109: }  // namespace

111: bool isWakeWord(const std::string& text, const std::vector<std::string>& configured) {
112:   const std::string actual = foldWakePhrase(text);
113:   if (actual.empty()) return false;
114:   for (const auto& candidate : configured) {
115:     if (matchesWakePhrase(actual, foldWakePhrase(candidate))) return true;
116:   }
117:   return false;
118: }

120: bool isWakeWord(const std::string& text, const std::string& configured) {
121:   const std::string wanted = foldWakePhrase(configured);
122:   return matchesWakePhrase(foldWakePhrase(text), wanted);
123: }

155: std::optional<PasswordToken> parsePasswordToken(const std::string& text) {
156:   auto value = normalize(text);
157:   if (value.empty()) return std::nullopt;
158:   if (const auto found = kControls.find(value); found != kControls.end())
159:     return PasswordToken{std::nullopt, found->second};
160:   if (const auto found = kSymbols.find(value); found != kSymbols.end())
161:     return PasswordToken{found->second, std::nullopt};
162: 
163:   if (value.rfind("upper_", 0) == 0 && value.size() == 7 && std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[6])))
164:     return PasswordToken{static_cast<char>(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[6]))), std::nullopt};
165:   if (value.rfind("lower_", 0) == 0 && value.size() == 7 && std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[6])))
166:     return PasswordToken{static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[6]))), std::nullopt};
167:   if (value.rfind("digit_", 0) == 0 && value.size() == 7 && std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[6])))
168:     return PasswordToken{value[6], std::nullopt};
169: 
170:   for (const std::string prefix : {"大写字母", "大写", "小写字母", "小写"}) {
171:     if (value.rfind(prefix, 0) == 0 && value.size() == prefix.size() + 1) {
172:       const unsigned char raw = static_cast<unsigned char>(value.back());
173:       if (!std::isalpha(raw)) return std::nullopt;
174:       const bool upper = prefix.rfind("大写", 0) == 0;
175:       return PasswordToken{static_cast<char>(upper ? std::toupper(raw) : std::tolower(raw)), std::nullopt};
176:     }
177:   }
178:   if (value.rfind("数字", 0) == 0) value.erase(0, std::string("数字").size());
179:   if (value.size() == 1 && std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[0])))
180:     return PasswordToken{value[0], std::nullopt};
181:   if (const char digit = chineseDigit(value); digit != '\0')
182:     return PasswordToken{digit, std::nullopt};
183:   if (value.size() == 1 && std::isalpha(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[0])))
184:     return PasswordToken{static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[0]))), std::nullopt};
185:   return std::nullopt;

1: # K7 + openvela 最小闭环操作清单
2: 
3: ## 目标
4: 
5: 只验证这一条完整流程：
6: 
7: ```text
8: 麦克风录音 → ASR 识别 → Wi-Fi 扫描 → TTS 播报 → 选择网络 → 一遍密码 → 连接
9: ```
10: 
11: 密码只输入一遍。说「完成」后立刻连接。密码错误、超时、找不到网络或其他失败，必须用 TTS 播报原因，清空缓冲后继续听密码，不要要求用户再确认一遍。
12: 
13: ## 无屏无键盘对齐（量产约束）
14: 
15: 真机没有屏幕、没有键盘。对齐要求如下，主机 CLI / 串口只用于工程师调试，不能当作产品交互：
16: 
17: 1. **唯一输入是麦克风 + ASR**。唤醒、选网、密码字符和控制词都必须能离线识别；禁止依赖键盘补录。
18: 2. **唯一输出是喇叭 + TTS**。所有提示、错误、下一步指令都用中文播报；禁止依赖屏幕菜单或打印给用户看。
19: 3. **密码不得回读、不得上屏、不得写日志**。只允许播报「已输入第 N 个字符」这类长度提示。
20: 4. **听不清要可恢复**。超时继续等待；可恢复识别错误播报「没有听清，请再说一次」，状态不变。
21: 5. **失败可语音重试**。连接失败不清空已选网络，播报原因后重新听密码；用户仍可说「重新选择网络」或「取消」。
22: 6. **开放网络也走连接**。无需密码，选中后直接 `wifi_connect(ssid, NULL, 0)`；失败则播报并回到选网。
23: 
24: ## 软件选型
25: 
26: - ASR：`sherpa-onnx` + 中文流式 Paraformer INT8
27: - TTS：`sherpa-onnx` + `vits-icefall-zh-aishell3`
28: - 系统：openvela；不要使用 `aplay`、`arecord`、`amixer`、`nmcli`
29: 
30: ## 开始前
31: 
32: 从当前 K7 openvela BSP 中找到：
33: 
34: 1. ES8388 录音接口；
35: 2. ES8388 PCM 播放和停止接口；
36: 3. VS6621SR80 Wi-Fi 扫描接口；
37: 4. VS6621SR80 Wi-Fi 连接接口，以及能否区分密码错误 / 超时 / 找不到网络。
38: 
39: ## 需要完成的代码
40: 
41: ### 1. `speech_engine_k7.c/cpp`
42: 
43: 实现 `include/voicelink/speech_engine.h` 中的四个函数：
44: 
45: - `voicelink_speech_init()`：加载 ASR、TTS 模型；成功返回 `0`。
46: - `voicelink_speech_speak()`：合成中文并通过 ES8388 播放；播完返回 `0`。
47: - `voicelink_speech_stop()`：停止当前播放。
48: - `voicelink_speech_recognize()`：录制一段语音并返回 UTF-8 识别结果。
49: 
50: ASR 返回值：
51: 
52: - `0`：识别成功；
53: - `1`：没有说话；
54: - `2`：听到了但没识别清楚；
55: - 负数：硬件或模型错误。
56: 
57: 最低识别范围：
58: 
59: - 唤醒：`你好，openvela` / `Hello，openvela`（大赛统一唤醒词，裸 `openvela` 也接受）；“小信”不能唤醒。KWS 热词表需覆盖这些形态；ASR 结果**原样返回即可**，大小写、空格、中英文标点由 core 侧 `isWakeWord()` 折叠后再剥掉礼貌前缀（你好/您好/嗨/嘿/哈喽/hello/hi/hey）比对，板级不要自行清洗。
60: - 选网：`网络一`～`网络五`、`重新扫描`、`取消`。
61: - 密码：大小写 A-Z、数字 0-9、常用符号、`完成`、`删除`、`清空`、`重输`、`取消`。
62: 
63: ### 2. `src/board_hooks_k7.c`
64: 
65: 补完扫描和连接，不要改业务状态机。
66: 
67: `voicelink_board_wifi_scan()`：
68: 
69: - 调用 VS6621SR80 的扫描接口；
70: - 填写 `ssid`、`rssi`、`secured` 和 `count`；
71: - 最多写入 `capacity` 条。
72: 
73: `voicelink_board_wifi_connect(ssid, password, password_len)`：
74: 
75: - 开放网络时 `password == NULL` 且 `password_len == 0`；
76: - 禁止把密码写入 syslog 或任何日志；
77: - 返回值：
78:   - `VOICELINK_WIFI_OK`（0）
79:   - `VOICELINK_WIFI_WRONG_PASSWORD`（1）
80:   - `VOICELINK_WIFI_TIMEOUT`（2）
81:   - `VOICELINK_WIFI_NOT_FOUND`（3）
82:   - `VOICELINK_WIFI_FAILED`（4）或负 errno
83: 
84: ## 编译和烧录
85: 
86: 将 `speech_engine_k7.c/cpp`、sherpa-onnx、ONNX Runtime 和模型加入现有 K7 openvela 工程，然后执行现有固件编译与烧录流程。
87: 
88: 应用集成命令：
89: 
90: ```sh
91: export OV_ROOT=/path/to/openvela
92: cd openvela-voicelink
93: chmod +x scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh
94: ./scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh
95: ./scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh --build
96: ```
97: 
98: ## 最小验收
99: 
100: 运行：
101: 
102: ```text
103: nsh> voicelink
104: ```
105: 
106: 依次验证（全程只靠语音，不要用键盘代替 ASR）：
107: 
108: 1. 说“小信”，程序无响应；
109: 2. 说“你好，openvela”，程序用中文问候；改说“Hello，openvela”同样问候；
110: 3. 程序扫描并播报附近网络；
111: 4. 说“网络一”，程序进入密码输入；
112: 5. 逐字符说出密码一遍，再说“完成”；
113: 6. 密码正确时播报“已连接到…”，流程结束；
114: 7. 密码错误或其他连接失败时播报原因，并允许重新输入，无需再确认第二遍；
115: 8. 串口日志没有出现密码内容。
116: 
117: 以上 8 项通过，即完成第一版最小闭环。其他性能和体验优化暂不处理。
118: 
119: ## 无法完成时回传
120: 
121: 只需回传：
122: 
123: - 编译错误全文；
124: - ES8388 和 VS6621SR80 的相关头文件；
125: - 实际使用的录音、播放、停止、扫描和连接函数名。

以下是完整的项目架构分析：

---

## 项目概述

**openvela VoiceLink** — 面向 K7 + openvela 的离线语音配网应用。用户通过语音完成 Wi-Fi 扫描、选网和密码输入，目标硬件为无屏无键盘的 IoT 设备。

---

## 架构分析

### 分层设计：Port/Adapter 模式

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               main.cpp (入口)                │
│  初始化硬件 → 创建 Controller → 主循环       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│         Controller (业务状态机)              │
│  core.cpp — 纯 C++17，无平台依赖            │
│  ├── ingest() → 分发到各状态处理             │
│  ├── handleNetwork() → 选网逻辑             │
│  ├── handlePassword() → 密码输入逻辑        │
│  └── tryConnect() → 连接与错误恢复          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│           Parsers (纯函数解析层)             │
│  parsers.cpp — 唤醒词/网络/密码解析          │
│  无副作用，可完全在主机单元测试               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│         Ports (抽象接口层)                   │
│  TtsPort / WifiPort / TextInputPort         │
│  ports.hpp — 纯虚类，定义硬件契约            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│       Platform Adapters (适配层)             │
│  platform.hpp → BoardHook* 实现             │
│  platform_openvela.cpp → C 桥接             │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│        Board Hooks (板级 C 接口)             │
│  board_hooks.h    — 通用 ABI               │
│  speech_engine.h  — ASR/TTS ABI            │
│  board_hooks_k7.c — K7 实现(待补)           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 状态机流转

```
WaitingWake → ScanningWifi → WaitingNetworkChoice → EnteringPassword → Completed
    ↑              ↓                  ↓                    ↓
    └──── (reset)  Error          重扫/取消           连接失败重试
```

### 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **密码安全** | `secureWipe()` 用 volatile 内存清零，析构时自动擦除，日志不泄露 |
| **Port/Adapter** | 业务逻辑与硬件完全解耦，主机可独立测试 |
| **弱符号桥接** | `platform_openvela.cpp` 用 `__attribute__((weak))` 提供默认桩，板级提供强符号覆盖 |
| **异常安全** | `#if defined(__cpp_exceptions)` 条件编译，嵌入式环境无异常也能运行 |
| **唤醒词折叠** | `foldWakePhrase()` 去标点+去空格，兼容 ASR 各种输出形态 |

---

## 代码完成度

| 模块 | 状态 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `core.cpp` 状态机 | **完成** | 全部 7 个状态、错误恢复、密码安全 |
| `parsers.cpp` 解析器 | **完成** | 唤醒词、网络选择、密码字符、控制词 |
| `ports.hpp` 接口契约 | **完成** | 3 个 Port 定义完整 |
| `platform_openvela.cpp` | **完成** | C 桥接层，弱符号桩 |
| `board_hooks_k7.c` | **未完成** | WiFi scan/connect 返回 `-ENOSYS` (TODO) |
| `speech_engine.h` | **未完成** | 仅有头文件声明，无实现 |
| 主机单元测试 | **完成** | 5 个测试文件，覆盖解析和状态机 |
| CMake 构建 | **完成** | 主机构建 + openvela 集成双模式 |
| Kconfig | **完成** | openvela menuconfig 集成 |

---

## 后续操作建议

### 1. 硬件侧（板级成员）— 阻塞项
- 实现 `speech_engine.h` 的 4 个函数（ASR/TTS，推荐 sherpa-onnx）
- 补完 `board_hooks_k7.c` 中 VS6621SR80 的 scan/connect
- 集成 ES8388 音频驱动

### 2. 软件侧可改进
- **测试框架**：当前用自定义 `CHECK` 宏，可考虑迁移到 Catch2/doctest 使输出更规范
- **密码输入体验**：当前字母默认小写，`大写A`/`upper_a` 需要额外前缀，可考虑上下文感知
- **网络播报**：最多 5 个网络，播报较长时可考虑分页机制

### 3. 提交前检查
- 运行 `cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build` 确保所有测试通过
- 确认 `logs/` 目录下的 AI Coding 日志已提交（比赛要求）
- `ENGINEER_CHECKLIST.md` 中 8 项验收标准全部通过

---

**总结**：软件侧代码质量较高，架构清晰，Port/Adapter 分层使得核心逻辑可在主机端完全测试。当前唯一的阻塞项是板级硬件驱动（speech_engine + WiFi hooks）的实现。
按以下要求修改代码，1， ASR/TTS，使用sherpa-onnx。2. 修改密码输出体验，默认小写，区分大写。

   conversation), which keeps original messages.

1: #!/bin/sh
2: # 把 VoiceLink 装进已有的 K7 openvela 树，可选编译。
3: #
4: #   export OV_ROOT=/path/to/openvela    # 内含 nuttx/ 与 apps/
5: #   ./scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh
6: #   ./scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh --build
7: #   ./scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh --configure=BOARD:nsh --build
8: #
9: # 之后编辑 apps/openvela-voicelink/src/board_hooks_k7.c ，烧录，nsh> voicelink
10: 
11: set -eu
12: 
13: SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
14: APP_SRC=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)
15: 
16: DO_BUILD=0
17: DO_CONFIGURE=""
18: for arg in "$@"; do
19:   case "$arg" in
20:     --build) DO_BUILD=1 ;;
21:     --configure)
22:       echo "usage: --configure=BOARD:CONFIG" >&2
23:       exit 2
24:       ;;
25:     --configure=*)
26:       DO_CONFIGURE=${arg#--configure=}
27:       ;;
28:     -h|--help)
29:       sed -n '2,12p' "$0"
30:       exit 0
31:       ;;
32:     *)
33:       echo "unknown arg: $arg" >&2
34:       exit 2
35:       ;;
36:   esac
37: done
38: 
39: if [ -z "${OV_ROOT:-}" ]; then
40:   echo "ERROR: 请设置 OV_ROOT（含 nuttx/ 和 apps/ 的 openvela 根目录）" >&2
41:   exit 1
42: fi
43: 
44: OV_NUTTX=${OV_NUTTX:-$OV_ROOT/nuttx}
45: OV_APPS=${OV_APPS:-$OV_ROOT/apps}
46: 
47: if [ ! -d "$OV_NUTTX" ]; then
48:   echo "ERROR: 找不到 $OV_NUTTX" >&2
49:   exit 1
50: fi
51: if [ ! -d "$OV_APPS" ]; then
52:   echo "ERROR: 找不到 $OV_APPS" >&2
53:   exit 1
54: fi
55: 
56: APP_DST=$OV_APPS/openvela-voicelink
57: echo "==> [1/5] 安装应用到 $APP_DST"
58: 
59: if [ -e "$APP_DST" ] && [ ! -L "$APP_DST" ]; then
60:   HOOK_BAK=""
61:   if [ -f "$APP_DST/src/board_hooks_k7.c" ]; then
62:     HOOK_BAK=$(mktemp)
63:     cp "$APP_DST/src/board_hooks_k7.c" "$HOOK_BAK"
64:   fi
65:   rm -rf "$APP_DST"
66: fi
67: 
68: if [ -L "$APP_DST" ]; then
69:   echo "    已是符号链接，保持不动"
70: else
71:   mkdir -p "$APP_DST"
72:   for item in Kconfig Make.defs Makefile include src docs; do
73:     if [ -e "$APP_SRC/$item" ]; then
74:       cp -a "$APP_SRC/$item" "$APP_DST/"
75:     fi
76:   done
77:   if [ -n "${HOOK_BAK:-}" ] && [ -f "$HOOK_BAK" ]; then
78:     cp "$HOOK_BAK" "$APP_DST/src/board_hooks_k7.c"
79:     rm -f "$HOOK_BAK"
80:   fi
81: fi
82: 
83: for f in Kconfig Make.defs Makefile include/voicelink/board_hooks.h src/board_hooks_k7.c; do
84:   if [ ! -e "$APP_DST/$f" ]; then
85:     echo "ERROR: 缺少 $APP_DST/$f" >&2
86:     exit 1
87:   fi
88: done
89: 
90: echo "==> [2/5] 注册 Kconfig"
91: KCONFIG_APPS=$OV_APPS/Kconfig
92: if [ -f "$KCONFIG_APPS" ] && ! grep -q 'openvela-voicelink/Kconfig' "$KCONFIG_APPS"; then
93:   printf '\nsource "openvela-voicelink/Kconfig"\n' >> "$KCONFIG_APPS"
94: fi
95: 
96: echo "==> [3/5] 打开 CONFIG_APP_VOICELINK"
97: if [ -n "$DO_CONFIGURE" ]; then
98:   ( cd "$OV_NUTTX" && ./tools/configure.sh -l "$DO_CONFIGURE" )
99: fi
100: 
101: if [ ! -f "$OV_NUTTX/.config" ]; then
102:   echo "ERROR: 没有 $OV_NUTTX/.config ，请先用你们的 K7 defconfig 配置，或加 --configure=板名:nsh" >&2
103:   exit 1
104: fi
105: 
106: cat >> "$OV_NUTTX/.config" << 'EOF'
107: 
108: CONFIG_APP_VOICELINK=y
109: CONFIG_APP_VOICELINK_PROGNAME="voicelink"
110: CONFIG_APP_VOICELINK_PRIORITY=100
111: CONFIG_APP_VOICELINK_STACKSIZE=16384
112: CONFIG_HAVE_CXX=y
113: CONFIG_LIBCXX=y
114: EOF
115: 
116: ( cd "$OV_NUTTX" && make olddefconfig )
117: 
118: echo "==> [4/5] 检查钩子文件"
119: if grep -q 'tts_speak not wired' "$APP_DST/src/board_hooks_k7.c"; then
120:   echo "    仍是空实现。请编辑: $APP_DST/src/board_hooks_k7.c"
121: fi
122: 
123: echo "==> [5/5] 编译"
124: if [ "$DO_BUILD" -eq 1 ]; then
125:   ( cd "$OV_NUTTX" && make -j"$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || echo 4)" )
126:   echo "    镜像: $OV_NUTTX/nuttx"
127: else
128:   echo "    跳过。需要时: cd $OV_NUTTX && make -j\$(nproc)"
129: fi
130: 
131: echo ""
132: echo "nsh> voicelink"
133: echo "说「小信」不应唤醒；说「你好，openvela」或「Hello，openvela」应问候并报网络。"

216:     return -errno;
217:   }
218: 
219:   /* Configure PCM input: 16 kHz / 16-bit / mono */
220: 
221:   const uint32_t sample_rate = 16000;
222:   struct audio_caps_s caps;
223:   caps.ac_len = sizeof(caps);
224:   caps.ac_type = AUDIO_TYPE_INPUT;
225:   caps.ac_channels = 1;
226:   caps.ac_chmask = AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO;
227:   caps.ac_samprate = sample_rate;
228:   caps.ac_sampwidth = 16;
229:   ioctl(fd, AUDIOIOC_CONFIGURE, (unsigned long)&caps);
230:   ioctl(fd, AUDIOIOC_START, 0);
231: 
232:   /* Record audio:
233:    * - Wake word: up to 3 s, stop early on 600 ms silence
234:    * - Network/password: up to 5 s, stop early on 800 ms silence
235:    * Silence threshold: RMS < 300 (16-bit scale)
236:    */
237: 
238:   const int is_wake = (grammar == VOICELINK_GRAMMAR_WAKE);
239:   const float max_seconds = is_wake ? 3.0f : 5.0f;
240:   const float silence_ms = is_wake ? 600.0f : 800.0f;
241:   const int32_t max_frames = (int32_t)(sample_rate * max_seconds);
242:   const int32_t silence_frames = (int32_t)(sample_rate * silence_ms / 1000);
243:   const int32_t chunk_frames = (int32_t)(sample_rate * 30 / 1000); /* 30 ms */
244: 
245:   int16_t* buf = (int16_t*)malloc(max_frames * sizeof(int16_t));
246:   if (!buf) {
247:     ioctl(fd, AUDIOIOC_STOP, 0);
248:     close(fd);
249:     pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_audio_lock);
250:     return -ENOMEM;
251:   }
252: 
253:   int32_t total = 0;
254:   int32_t trailing_silence = 0;
255:   int has_speech = 0;
256: 
257:   while (total < max_frames) {
258:     const int32_t want = max_frames - total;
259:     int32_t count = want < chunk_frames ? want : chunk_frames;
260:     const ssize_t n = read(fd, buf + total, count * sizeof(int16_t));
261:     if (n <= 0) break;
262:     const int32_t frames = (int32_t)(n / sizeof(int16_t));
263:     total += frames;

265:     /* Compute RMS for voice activity detection */
266: 
267:     int64_t sum_sq = 0;
268:     for (int32_t i = 0; i < frames; ++i)
269:       sum_sq += (int64_t)buf[total - frames + i] *
270:                 buf[total - frames + i];
271:     const float rms = sqrtf((float)(sum_sq / frames));
272: 
273:     if (rms > 300.0f) {
274:       has_speech = 1;
275:       trailing_silence = 0;
276:     } else {
277:       trailing_silence += frames;
278:       if (has_speech && trailing_silence >= silence_frames)
279:         break; /* End of utterance */
280:     }

282:     /* Early exit: wake word timeout if no speech within 1.5 s */
283: 
284:     if (!has_speech && total > (int32_t)(sample_rate * 1.5f))

288:   ioctl(fd, AUDIOIOC_STOP, 0);
289:   close(fd);

291:   /* If no speech detected, return timeout */

293:   if (!has_speech || total < (int32_t)(sample_rate * 0.1f)) {
294:     free(buf);
295:     pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_audio_lock);
296:     return VOICELINK_SPEECH_TIMEOUT;

302:       SherpaOnnxOfflineRecognizerCreateStream(g_recognizer);

text:
模型从 GitHub Releases 下载，**先下载到主机，再传到板子上**。具体步骤：

## 1. 在主机下载模型

**TTS 模型**（约 30MB）：
```sh
wget https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/tts-models/vits-icefall-zh-aishell3.tar.bz2
tar xvf vits-icefall-zh-aishell3.tar.bz2
```

**ASR 模型**（约 230MB，推荐 bilingual 流式 paraformer）：
```sh
wget https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models/sherpa-onnx-streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en.tar.bz2
tar xvf sherpa-onnx-streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en.tar.bz2
```

## 2. 传到 K7 板子

```sh
# 通过串口/adb/SCP 传到板上
adb push vits-icefall-zh-aishell3/ /data/voicelink/models/tts/
adb push sherpa-onnx-streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en/ /data/voicelink/models/asr/
```

板上目录结构应为：
```
/data/voicelink/models/
├── tts/
│   ├── model.onnx
│   ├── tokens.txt
│   └── dict/          # jieba.dict.utf8, phone.fst, new_heteronym.fst 等
└── asr/
    ├── model.onnx     # 或 encoder.int8.onnx + decoder.int8.onnx
    ├── tokens.txt
    └── rule.fst       # 可选，数字/标点纠正规则
```

## 3. 如果 GitHub 下载慢

国内可以用 ModelScope 镜像：
- TTS: `https://modelscope.cn/models/k2-fsa/vits-icefall-zh-aishell3`
- ASR: `https://modelscope.cn/models/pengzhendong/sherpa-onnx-paraformer-zh-streaming`

或者在 Windows 上下载好，用 USB 或 SCP 传到板子上。

127: /* voicelink_speech_speak — synthesize and play through ES8388                 */
128: /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
129: 
130: int voicelink_speech_speak(const char* utf8_text)
131: {
132:   if (!utf8_text || !g_tts) return -EINVAL;
133: 
134:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_audio_lock);
135:   g_stop_flag = 0;
136: 
137:   const SherpaOnnxGeneratedAudio* audio =
138:       SherpaOnnxOfflineTtsGenerate(g_tts, utf8_text, 0, 0.8f);
139:   if (!audio || !audio->samples || audio->n == 0) {
140:     pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_audio_lock);
141:     syslog(LOG_ERR, "voicelink: TTS synthesis failed\n");
142:     return -EIO;
143:   }
144: 
145:   const int fd = open(AUDIO_OUT_DEV, O_WRONLY);
146:   if (fd < 0) {
147:     SherpaOnnxDestroyOfflineTtsGeneratedAudio(audio);
148:     pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_audio_lock);
149:     syslog(LOG_ERR, "voicelink: cannot open " AUDIO_OUT_DEV "\n");
150:     return -errno;
151:   }
152: 
153:   /* Configure PCM output: 16 kHz / 16-bit / mono */
154: 
155:   struct audio_caps_s caps;
156:   caps.ac_len = sizeof(caps);
157:   caps.ac_type = AUDIO_TYPE_OUTPUT;
158:   caps.ac_channels = 1;
159:   caps.ac_chmask = AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO;
160:   caps.ac_samprate = audio->sample_rate;
161:   caps.ac_sampwidth = 16;
162:   ioctl(fd, AUDIOIOC_CONFIGURE, (unsigned long)&caps);
163: 
164:   /* Write samples in 40 ms chunks (640 frames @ 16 kHz) */
165: 
166:   const int16_t* samples = audio->samples;
167:   const int32_t total = (int32_t)audio->n;
168:   const int32_t chunk_frames = (int32_t)(audio->sample_rate * 40 / 1000);
169:   int32_t offset = 0;
170:   int ret = 0;
171: 
172:   while (offset < total && !g_stop_flag) {
173:     int32_t count = total - offset;
174:     if (count > chunk_frames) count = chunk_frames;
175:     const ssize_t written =
176:         write(fd, samples + offset, count * sizeof(int16_t));
177:     if (written < 0) {
178:       ret = -errno;
179:       break;
180:     }
181:     offset += (int32_t)(written / sizeof(int16_t));
182:   }
183: 
184:   close(fd);
185:   SherpaOnnxDestroyOfflineTtsGeneratedAudio(audio);
186:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_audio_lock);
187:   return ret;

200: /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
201: /* voicelink_speech_recognize — record one utterance, run offline ASR          */
202: /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
203: 
204: int voicelink_speech_recognize(enum voicelink_grammar grammar,
205:                                 char* utf8_text, size_t capacity)
206: {
207:   if (!utf8_text || capacity == 0 || !g_recognizer)
208:     return -EINVAL;
209: 
210:   utf8_text[0] = '\0';
211: 
212:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_audio_lock);
213: 
214:   /* Open microphone */
215: 
216:   const int fd = open(AUDIO_INP_DEV, O_RDONLY);
217:   if (fd < 0) {
218:     pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_audio_lock);
219:     syslog(LOG_ERR, "voicelink: cannot open " AUDIO_INP_DEV "\n");
220:     return -errno;
221:   }
222: 
223:   /* Configure PCM input: 16 kHz / 16-bit / mono */
224: 
225:   const uint32_t sample_rate = 16000;
226:   struct audio_caps_s caps;
227:   caps.ac_len = sizeof(caps);
228:   caps.ac_type = AUDIO_TYPE_INPUT;
229:   caps.ac_channels = 1;
230:   caps.ac_chmask = AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO;
231:   caps.ac_samprate = sample_rate;
232:   caps.ac_sampwidth = 16;
233:   ioctl(fd, AUDIOIOC_CONFIGURE, (unsigned long)&caps);
234:   ioctl(fd, AUDIOIOC_START, 0);
235: 
236:   /* Record audio:
237:    * - Wake word: up to 3 s, stop early on 600 ms silence
238:    * - Network/password: up to 5 s, stop early on 800 ms silence
239:    * Silence threshold: RMS < 300 (16-bit scale)
240:    */
241: 
242:   const int is_wake = (grammar == VOICELINK_GRAMMAR_WAKE);
243:   const float max_seconds = is_wake ? 3.0f : 5.0f;
244:   const float silence_ms = is_wake ? 600.0f : 800.0f;
245:   const int32_t max_frames = (int32_t)(sample_rate * max_seconds);
246:   const int32_t silence_frames = (int32_t)(sample_rate * silence_ms / 1000);
247:   const int32_t chunk_frames = (int32_t)(sample_rate * 30 / 1000); /* 30 ms */
248: 
249:   int16_t* buf = (int16_t*)malloc(max_frames * sizeof(int16_t));
250:   if (!buf) {
251:     ioctl(fd, AUDIOIOC_STOP, 0);
252:     close(fd);
253:     pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_audio_lock);
254:     return -ENOMEM;
255:   }
256: 
257:   int32_t total = 0;
258:   int32_t trailing_silence = 0;
259:   int has_speech = 0;
260: 
261:   while (total < max_frames) {
262:     const int32_t want = max_frames - total;
263:     int32_t count = want < chunk_frames ? want : chunk_frames;
264:     const ssize_t n = read(fd, buf + total, count * sizeof(int16_t));
265:     if (n <= 0) break;
266:     const int32_t frames = (int32_t)(n / sizeof(int16_t));
267:     total += frames;
268: 
269:     /* Compute RMS for voice activity detection */
270: 
271:     int64_t sum_sq = 0;
272:     for (int32_t i = 0; i < frames; ++i)
273:       sum_sq += (int64_t)buf[total - frames + i] *
274:                 buf[total - frames + i];
275:     const float rms = sqrtf((float)(sum_sq / frames));
276: 
277:     if (rms > 300.0f) {
278:       has_speech = 1;
279:       trailing_silence = 0;
280:     } else {
281:       trailing_silence += frames;
282:       if (has_speech && trailing_silence >= silence_frames)
283:         break; /* End of utterance */
284:     }
285: 
286:     /* Early exit: wake word timeout if no speech within 1.5 s */
287: 
288:     if (!has_speech && total > (int32_t)(sample_rate * 1.5f))
289:       break;
290:   }
291: 
292:   ioctl(fd, AUDIOIOC_STOP, 0);
293:   close(fd);
294: 
295:   /* If no speech detected, return timeout */
296: 
297:   if (!has_speech || total < (int32_t)(sample_rate * 0.1f)) {
298:     free(buf);
299:     pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_audio_lock);
300:     return VOICELINK_SPEECH_TIMEOUT;
301:   }
302: 
303:   /* Run offline ASR */
304: 
305:   const SherpaOnnxOfflineStream* stream =
306:       SherpaOnnxOfflineRecognizerCreateStream(g_recognizer);
307:   if (!stream) {
308:     free(buf);
309:     pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_audio_lock);
310:     return -EIO;
311:   }
312: 
313:   SherpaOnnxOfflineRecognizerAcceptWaveform(stream, sample_rate,
314:                                              buf, total);
315:   SherpaOnnxOfflineRecognizerDecode(stream);
316:   const SherpaOnnxOfflineRecognizerResult* result =
317:       SherpaOnnxOfflineRecognizerGetResult(stream);
318: 
319:   int ret;
320:   if (result && result->text && result->text[0] != '\0') {
321:     strncpy(utf8_text, result->text, capacity - 1);
322:     utf8_text[capacity - 1] = '\0';
323:     ret = VOICELINK_SPEECH_OK;
324:   } else {
325:     ret = VOICELINK_SPEECH_RETRY;
326:   }
327: 
328:   if (result) SherpaOnnxDestroyOfflineRecognizerResult(result);
329:   SherpaOnnxOfflineRecognizerDestroyStream(stream);
330:   free(buf);
331:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_audio_lock);

# `wapi` WAPI (Wireless API)[](#wapi-wapi-wireless-api "Permalink to this heading")

One can provide use `wapi` to connect to Access Points, configure an Access Point, set Wi-Fi related configurations and get information about it.

Currently, `wapi` is the only interface provided to handle Wi-Fi networking from the userspace.

# Commands[](#commands "Permalink to this heading")

This page shows `wapi` commands, their arguments and outputs. For a complete list of `wapi` commands available to the system, just run `wapi`:

nsh> wapi
Usage:
        wapi show         <ifname>
        wapi scan         <ifname>
        wapi scan\_results <ifname>
        wapi ip           <ifname> <IP address>
        wapi mask         <ifname> <mask>
        wapi freq         <ifname> <frequency>  <index/flag>
        wapi essid        <ifname> <essid>      <index/flag>
        wapi psk          <ifname> <passphrase> <index/flag> <wpa>
        wapi disconnect   <ifname>
        wapi mode         <ifname>              <index/mode>
        wapi ap           <ifname>              <MAC address>
        wapi bitrate      <ifname> <bitrate>    <index/flag>
        wapi txpower      <ifname> <txpower>    <index/flag>
        wapi country      <ifname> <country code>
        wapi sense        <ifname>
        wapi pta\_prio     <ifname>  <index/flag>
        wapi help

Frequency Flags:
        \[0\] WAPI\_FREQ\_AUTO
        \[1\] WAPI\_FREQ\_FIXED

ESSID Flags:
        \[0\] WAPI\_ESSID\_OFF
        \[1\] WAPI\_ESSID\_ON

Passphrase algorithm Flags:
        \[0\] WPA\_ALG\_NONE
        \[1\] WPA\_ALG\_WEP
        \[2\] WPA\_ALG\_TKIP
        \[3\] WPA\_ALG\_CCMP

Passphrase WPA version:
        \[0\] WPA\_VER\_NONE
        \[1\] WPA\_VER\_1

        \[3\] WPA\_VER\_3

        \[1\] WAPI\_MODE\_ADHOC

        \[5\] WAPI\_MODE\_SECOND

        \[7\] WAPI\_MODE\_MESH

        \[0\] WAPI\_BITRATE\_AUTO
        \[1\] WAPI\_BITRATE\_FIXED

## Arguments[](#arguments "Permalink to this heading")

Command’s arguments are available on `wapi`’s usage helper.

Note

`<>` means a required argument and `[]` an optional one.

A short explanation of them follows:

### `<ifname>`[](#ifname "Permalink to this heading")

The interface name is arch-dependent and it’s usually set for a specific operating mode. For instance, `wlan0` would be an interface used for STA mode and `wlan1` for SoftAP.

Please refer to the [Supported Platforms](../../../platforms/index.html) for platform-specific definitions. As an example, please check [ESP32 Wi-Fi Station Mode](../../../platforms/xtensa/esp32/index.html#esp32-wi-fi-sta) and [ESP32 Wi-Fi SoftAP Mode](../../../platforms/xtensa/esp32/index.html#esp32-wi-fi-softap) Wi-Fi sections.

### `<index/flag>`[](#index-flag "Permalink to this heading")

The `<index/flag>` can be used as a numerical or textual value. For instance, considering the `wapi psk` command, one could use indistinctly:

nsh> wapi psk wlan0 mypasswd 3
nsh> wapi psk wlan0 mypasswd WPA\_ALG\_CCMP

# Configuring a Wireless Network[](#configuring-a-wireless-network "Permalink to this heading")

`wapi` is used to connect to an Access Point by setting its parameters.

Note

Usually, one single wireless interface refers to an operational mode: Station Mode (STA) or SoftAP. For instance, `wlan0` may refer to the STA mode and `wlan1`. Setting the passphrase and the ESSID of a STA-enabled interface would make it connect to a wireless network while setting the same parameters for a SoftAP-enabled interface would provide a network wireless with these connection parameters. Please check [ESP32 Wi-Fi Station Mode (wlan0)](../../../platforms/xtensa/esp32/index.html#esp32-wi-fi-sta) and [ESP32 Wi-Fi SoftAP Mode (wlan1)](../../../platforms/xtensa/esp32/index.html#esp32-wi-fi-softap) sections.

## Setting the Passphrase[](#setting-the-passphrase "Permalink to this heading")

`wapi psk` command is used for setting the AP authentication security. Its arguments are:

wapi psk <ifname> <passphrase> <index/flag> \[wpa\]

-   `<ifname>` is the name of the interface set as Station Mode (STA);
    
-   `<passphrase>` is the password. Its length depends on the authentication algorithm. Please note that `wapi psk` command is also used to set auth as open, but this parameter comes next, so it may be necessary to set a “dummy” passphrase just to set auth to none;
    
-   `<index/flag>` can be set numerically or textually, as follows:
    

> -   \[0\] WPA\_ALG\_NONE - to connect to an open AP;
>     
> -   \[1\] WPA\_ALG\_WEP - to connect to a WEP-secured AP (not recommended);
>     
> -   \[2\] WPA\_ALG\_TKIP - to use TKIP algorithm (not recommended);
>     
> -   \[3\] WPA\_ALG\_CCMP - to use CCMP algorithm (recommended);
>     

-   `[wpa]` sets the WPA version (if applicable):
    

> -   \[0\] WPA\_VER\_NONE;
>     
> -   \[1\] WPA\_VER\_1;
>     
> -   \[2\] WPA\_VER\_2 (default, if not selected otherwise);
>     
> -   \[3\] WPA\_VER\_3;
>     

## Setting the Network Name (ESSID)[](#setting-the-network-name-essid "Permalink to this heading")

The name of the Wireless Network can be set using `wapi essid` command:

wapi essid <ifname> <essid> <index/flag>

-   `<ifname>` is the name of the interface set as Station Mode (STA);
    
-   `<essid>` is the name of the Wireless Network;
    
-   `<index/flag>` selects whether to connect to the AP or not:
    

> -   \[0\] WAPI\_ESSID\_OFF - Don’t connect to the AP;
>     
> -   \[1\] WAPI\_ESSID\_ON - Connect to the AP indicated by the provided ESSID;
>     
> -   \[2\] WAPI\_ESSID\_DELAY\_ON - Delay AP connection;
>     

## Examples[](#examples "Permalink to this heading")

### Connecting to an Open Network[](#connecting-to-an-open-network "Permalink to this heading")

wapi psk wlan0 mypasswd WPA\_ALG\_NONE
wapi essid wlan0 myssid WAPI\_ESSID\_ON

or, equivalently

wapi psk wlan0 mypasswd 0
wapi essid wlan0 myssid 1

### Connecting to a WPA2-PSK Network[](#connecting-to-a-wpa2-psk-network "Permalink to this heading")

wapi psk wlan0 mypasswd WPA\_ALG\_CCMP
wapi essid wlan0 myssid WAPI\_ESSID\_ON

or, equivalently:

> wapi psk wlan0 mypasswd 3
> wapi essid wlan0 myssid 1

### Connecting to a WPA3-SAE Network[](#connecting-to-a-wpa3-sae-network "Permalink to this heading")

wapi psk wlan0 mypasswd WPA\_ALG\_CCMP WPA\_VER\_3
wapi essid wlan0 myssid WAPI\_ESSID\_ON

or, equivalently:

wapi psk wlan0 mypasswd 3 3
wapi essid wlan0 myssid 1

### Connecting to a Hidden (WPA2-PSK) Network[](#connecting-to-a-hidden-wpa2-psk-network "Permalink to this heading")

wapi psk wlan0 mypasswd WPA\_ALG\_CCMP
wapi essid wlan0 myssid WAPI\_ESSID\_DELAY\_ON
wapi ap wlan0 aa:bb:cc:dd:dd:ff

or, equivalently:

wapi psk wlan0 mypasswd 3
wapi essid wlan0 myssid 2
wapi ap wlan0 aa:bb:cc:dd:dd:ff

### 第一步：准备 openvela 工作区

```sh
# 1. 初始化 openvela 工作区（如果还没有）
mkdir -p ~/openvela && cd ~/openvela
repo init -u https://github.com/nickolay/openvela-manifest.git
repo sync -j8

# 2. 克隆 sherpa-onnx 并编译为 NuttX 静态库
cd ~/openvela
git clone https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx.git
cd sherpa-onnx
mkdir build-arm && cd build-arm
cmake .. \
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=../cmake/nuttx-toolchain.cmake \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DSHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_C_API=ON \
  -DSHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_PYTHON=OFF \
  -DSHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_BINARY=OFF
make -j8
# 产出: libsherpa-onnx-c-api.a, libonnxruntime.a
```

```sh

adb push models/tts/vits-icefall-zh-aishell3/rule.far /data/voicelink/models/tts/

# K7 + openvela 最小闭环操作清单

## 目标

只验证这一条完整流程：

```text
麦克风录音 → ASR 识别 → Wi-Fi 扫描 → TTS 播报 → 选择网络 → 一遍密码 → 连接
```

密码只输入一遍。说「完成」后立刻连接。密码错误、超时、找不到网络或其他失败，必须用 TTS 播报原因，清空缓冲后继续听密码，不要要求用户再确认一遍。

## 无屏无键盘对齐（量产约束）

真机没有屏幕、没有键盘。对齐要求如下，主机 CLI / 串口只用于工程师调试，不能当作产品交互：

1. **唯一输入是麦克风 + ASR**。唤醒、选网、密码字符和控制词都必须能离线识别；禁止依赖键盘补录。
2. **唯一输出是喇叭 + TTS**。所有提示、错误、下一步指令都用中文播报；禁止依赖屏幕菜单或打印给用户看。
3. **密码不得回读、不得上屏、不得写日志**。只允许播报「已输入第 N 个字符」这类长度提示。
4. **听不清要可恢复**。超时继续等待；可恢复识别错误播报「没有听清，请再说一次」，状态不变。
5. **失败可语音重试**。连接失败不清空已选网络，播报原因后重新听密码；用户仍可说「重新选择网络」或「取消」。
6. **开放网络也走连接**。无需密码，选中后直接 `wifi_connect(ssid, NULL, 0)`；失败则播报并回到选网。

## 软件选型

- ASR：`sherpa-onnx` + 流式 Paraformer Bilingual INT8
- TTS：`sherpa-onnx` + `vits-icefall-zh-aishell3`
- Wi-Fi：NuttX wapi（Wireless API）库
- 系统：openvela；不要使用 `aplay`、`arecord`、`amixer`、`nmcli`

## 代码实现状态

所有软件代码已完成：

- `src/speech_engine_k7.cpp` — sherpa-onnx 实现（流式 Paraformer ASR + vits-zh TTS）
- `src/board_hooks_k7.c` — NuttX wapi 实现（WiFi scan + connect）
- `src/core.cpp` — 业务状态机（含大小写切换）
- `src/parsers.cpp` — 语音文本解析

## 完整 NuttX 板端构建指令

### 第一步：准备 openvela 工作区

```sh
# 1. 初始化 openvela 工作区（如果还没有）
mkdir -p ~/openvela && cd ~/openvela
repo init -u https://github.com/nickolay/openvela-manifest.git
repo sync -j8

# 2. 编译 sherpa-onnx 为 NuttX 静态库
#    参考: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/blob/master/cmake/nuttx-toolchain.cmake
cd ~/openvela
git clone https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx.git
cd sherpa-onnx && mkdir build-arm && cd build-arm
cmake .. \
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=../cmake/nuttx-toolchain.cmake \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DSHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_C_API=ON \
  -DSHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_PYTHON=OFF \
  -DSHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_BINARY=OFF
make -j8
# 产出: libsherpa-onnx-c-api.a, libonnxruntime.a
```

### 第二步：集成 VoiceLink 应用

```sh
export OV_ROOT=~/openvela
cd <this-repo>/app/openvela-voicelink
chmod +x scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh
./scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh
```

### 第三步：部署模型到板上

```sh
# ASR 模型（只需 INT8 版本，约 226 MB）
adb push models/asr/sherpa-onnx-streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en/encoder.int8.onnx /data/voicelink/models/asr/
adb push models/asr/sherpa-onnx-streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en/decoder.int8.onnx /data/voicelink/models/asr/
adb push models/asr/sherpa-onnx-streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en/tokens.txt /data/voicelink/models/asr/

# TTS 模型（约 30 MB）
adb push models/tts/vits-icefall-zh-aishell3/model.onnx /data/voicelink/models/tts/
adb push models/tts/vits-icefall-zh-aishell3/tokens.txt /data/voicelink/models/tts/
adb push models/tts/vits-icefall-zh-aishell3/lexicon.txt /data/voicelink/models/tts/
adb push models/tts/vits-icefall-zh-aishell3/rule.far /data/voicelink/models/tts/
```

### 第四步：menuconfig 配置

```sh
cd ~/openvela/nuttx
./build.sh <board-config-path> menuconfig
```

确认以下选项已开启：

```
Application Configuration  --->
  Demos  --->
    [*] OpenVela voice provisioning assistant

Networking Support  --->
  [*] Networking support
  [*] TCP/IP networking

Wireless Support  --->
  [*] Wireless API (WAPI)

C Library  --->
  [*] C++ support
```

### 第五步：编译固件

```sh
cd ~/openvela/nuttx
./build.sh <board-config-path> -j8
# 或
./scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh --build
```

### 第六步：烧录并运行

```sh
# 按 K7 烧录流程烧录固件
# ...

# 启动
nsh> voicelink
```

### 必需的 NuttX 配置项

| 配置项 | 值 | 说明 |
|--------|-----|------|
| `CONFIG_APP_VOICELINK` | y | 启用 VoiceLink |
| `CONFIG_HAVE_CXX` | y | C++ 支持 |
| `CONFIG_LIBCXX` | y | libc++ |
| `CONFIG_WIRELESS_WAPI` | y | WiFi API 库 |
| `CONFIG_NET` | y | 网络协议栈 |
| `CONFIG_NET_TCP` | y | TCP 支持 |
| `CONFIG_NET_UDP` | y | UDP 支持 |
| `CONFIG_NETUTILS_DHCPC` | y | DHCP 客户端 |

## 最小验收

运行：

```text
nsh> voicelink
```

依次验证（全程只靠语音，不要用键盘代替 ASR）：

1. 说"小信"，程序无响应；
2. 说"你好，openvela"，程序用中文问候；改说"Hello，openvela"同样问候；
3. 程序扫描并播报附近网络；
4. 说"网络一"，程序进入密码输入；
5. 逐字符说出密码一遍，再说"完成"；
6. 密码正确时播报"已连接到…"，流程结束；
7. 密码错误或其他连接失败时播报原因，并允许重新输入，无需再确认第二遍；
8. 串口日志没有出现密码内容。

以上 8 项通过，即完成第一版最小闭环。其他性能和体验优化暂不处理。

- ES8388 和 VS6621SR80 的相关头文件；
- 实际使用的录音、播放、停止、扫描和连接函数名。

### 4.2 K7 + openvela 集成

所有代码（含板级接口）均已完成。集成只需运行一个脚本：

```sh
# 1. 下载模型（见下方命令）
# 2. 集成到 openvela 工作区
export OV_ROOT=~/openvela
cd app/openvela-voicelink
./scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh
# 3. 编译
./scripts/integrate-k7-openvela.sh --build
# 4. 烧录后运行
nsh> voicelink
```

下载 sherpa-onnx 模型（约 256 MB）：

```sh
cd app/openvela-voicelink
mkdir -p models/asr models/tts

# ASR: streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en (INT8)
curl -L -o /tmp/asr.tar.bz2 \
  https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models/sherpa-onnx-streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en.tar.bz2
tar xjf /tmp/asr.tar.bz2 -C models/asr --strip-components=1 \
  sherpa-onnx-streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en/encoder.int8.onnx \
  sherpa-onnx-streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en/decoder.int8.onnx \
  sherpa-onnx-streaming-paraformer-bilingual-zh-en/tokens.txt
rm /tmp/asr.tar.bz2

# TTS: vits-icefall-zh-aishell3
curl -L -o /tmp/tts.tar.bz2 \
  https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/tts-models/vits-icefall-zh-aishell3.tar.bz2
tar xjf /tmp/tts.tar.bz2 -C models/tts --strip-components=1
rm /tmp/tts.tar.bz2
```

模型部署到板上：

```sh
adb push models/asr/encoder.int8.onnx /data/voicelink/models/asr/
adb push models/asr/decoder.int8.onnx /data/voicelink/models/asr/
adb push models/asr/tokens.txt        /data/voicelink/models/asr/
adb push models/tts/model.onnx        /data/voicelink/models/tts/
adb push models/tts/tokens.txt        /data/voicelink/models/tts/
adb push models/tts/lexicon.txt       /data/voicelink/models/tts/
adb push models/tts/rule.far          /data/voicelink/models/tts/
```

完整操作清单和八项验收步骤见 `app/openvela-voicelink/docs/ENGINEER_CHECKLIST.md`。
